name: Thijs Reuten, Nina Carberry - Après le § 125 - Am 2
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement
part_text: 36a. Welcomes the mutual commitment to uphold international law and the European Convention on Human Rights (ECHR) expressed by the UK Prime Minister and the President of the Commission in their joint statement of 2 October 2024 on enhancing strategic cooperation and in the Joint Statement of the EU-UK summit of 19 May 2025; recalls that the general conditions for the application of Part Three, as stipulated under Article 524(1) of the TCA, are long-standing respect for democracy, the rule of law and the protection of the fundamental rights and freedoms of individuals, including those set out in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and the ECHR, as well as the importance of giving effect to the rights and freedoms secured in the ECHR domestically; reiterates that these conditions must be fully guaranteed for the TCA to be applied and implemented;
